Name: Main AI Controller
Description: Low-power System-on-Chip (SoC) for AI inference and control, with integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

Name: MicroSD Card Module
Description: Provides external storage for the operating system and AI model files via SPI interface.

Name: USB-C Wall Adapter
Description: Provides regulated 5V DC power from a wall outlet to the main controller.

Name: Server Enclosure Base
Description: 3D-printed bottom housing for the server, integrating mounts for the ESP32-S3 and a slot for the MicroSD module. Includes cutouts for USB-C power and ventilation.

Name: Server Enclosure Lid
Description: 3D-printed top cover for the server enclosure, designed with passive cooling vents.

Name: M2 PCB Standoffs
Description: Used to mount the main AI controller PCB to the enclosure base.

Name: M2 Screws for PCB
Description: Secure the ESP32-S3 PCB to the M2 standoffs.

Name: M3 Heat Set Inserts
Description: Provide strong, reusable screw threads in the 3D-printed enclosure base for attaching the lid.

Name: M3 Screws for Enclosure
Description: Secure the enclosure lid to the enclosure base via M3 heat set inserts.
